jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Design - Ecosystem
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

User Experience

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Slack & The Role

Slack is at an inflection point. We're evolving from the world's most beloved team communication tool into an AI operating system for work, where humans and agents get things done together. The developer platform is how that future comes to life: it's the ecosystem that lets builders at every scale extend Slack with agents and apps, creating them, managing them, and distributing them through the Slack Marketplace.

As Senior Director, Product Design - Ecosystem, you'll hold and continuously refine the design vision for the developer experience across Slack's platform, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership. This is a player-coach role: you'll build and grow a small team of designers while staying hands-on in the design work yourself. You'll report to the Vice President, Product Design.

The Opportunity: Defining How the World Builds on Slack

You'll own design across the platform's full arc: what agents do inside Slack, how they're built, how they're managed and discovered, and how partners bring theirs to the ecosystem. As AI redefines both how software gets built and how work gets done, you'll shape what that developer experience becomes. The open questions you'll answer:

The Agent Experience: What should agents do inside Slack, and how do people build them now that AI has changed what "building" means?
Management: How do developers and admins run a growing ecosystem of agents with confidence?
Discovery: How do people find and trust the right agents in the marketplace?
Partners: How do we host partners like OpenAI, Anthropic, Cognition, and GitHub so their agents feel native to Slack?

Key Responsibilities

Design Vision: Hold and continuously refine the long-range design vision for the platform, in close partnership with product and engineering leadership
End-to-End Platform Design: Drive design across the full developer lifecycle: defining what agents do in Slack, agent creation, install and management, and marketplace discovery
Partner Experience: Shape how partners building on Slack (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cognition, GitHub, and more) bring their agents into the ecosystem
Hands-On Craft: Contribute directly to the design work as a player-coach, setting the craft bar for the team
Team Leadership: Grow and develop the platform design team, owning staffing and career development for the designers on it

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of product design experience, including work on developer-facing or highly technical products
Experience managing and growing design teams
Hands-on experience with AI and vibe-coding tools, and a solid understanding of developer workflows
A track record of partnering with product and engineering leadership to define and refine product direction through design

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing marketplace or agent-discovery experiences
Experience bringing third-party agentic experiences into a product
Experience designing multiplayer or collaborative use cases
Deep familiarity with Slack's platform surfaces and how its ecosystem works

What Makes This Role Different

This role combines the altitude of owning a platform's design vision with the hands-on latitude of a builder. You'll shape how developers build on Slack in an era where the nature of "building" itself is changing, and you'll grow the team doing that work.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.title: Head of Academic Partners & Programs, Fauna Robotics
jobs.description:
Description

Fauna Robotics is building the future of personal robotics — and we want it to be the best platform for researchers and developers to build on. We’re looking for a leader to build and scale our academic segment: the programs, partnerships, and mechanisms that put Fauna robots into the hands of the world’s top robotics researchers and turn them into a thriving, self-reinforcing community.

You'll own the strategy, the relationships, and the sales channel end-to-end — from a researcher's first pilot to institution-wide adoption. You will own how labs evaluate, acquire, and expand their Fauna fleets. You'll design the grant and phased-access programs that put robots in researchers' hands, and run the pilots that prove them out. You'll represent Fauna where researchers gather — ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI — and cultivate a community of people building on our platform.

You will be Fauna’s primary point of engagement with the robotics research community. You’ll own the strategy and the relationships end-to-end — from qualifying a priority lab to scaling adoption across an entire institution. You’ll design the grant and phased-access programs that put robots in researchers’ hands, and run the pilots that prove them out. You’ll represent Fauna where researchers gather — ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI — and cultivate a community of people building on our platform. And you’ll own the sales channel for the segment — the paths by which labs evaluate, acquire, and expand their Fauna fleets.

Just as importantly, you’ll be the bridge between that community and our product org — translating what researchers discover into a clearer roadmap, better robots, and a stronger talent pipeline. This is a role for someone who works shoulder-to-shoulder with scientists and AI researchers, knows the rhythms of academic life, and wants to build the definitive research robotics platform with them.

This role owns the research/academic segment end-to-end as its relationship, program, sales, and customer-success lead. You’ll work hand-in-hand with partner functions — product, fleet operations & logistics, data/telemetry engineering, and our broader ecosystem team — who own the shared infrastructure, so you can stay focused on strategy, relationships, and impact.

Key job responsibilities

Segment Strategy & Sales

Own the strategy for Fauna’s academic segment: map and prioritize target institutions and labs, define what makes Fauna the platform of choice for researchers, and set the adoption plan.
Manage our pipeline of funded labs, principal investigators, and technical champions — qualifying opportunities on research value, funding path, influence, and expansion potential.
Own the sales channel for the research segment — the paths by which labs and institutions acquire, deploy, and grow their Fauna fleets, always grounded in research fit.
Partner with fleet operations, finance, and legal to structure the grant, sponsored-research, pricing, and purchase options that fit how universities actually buy.
Build repeatable paths and clean handoffs from an individual researcher to lab- and institution-wide adoption.
Serve as the connection between Amazon-internal research and academic teams and Fauna product/engineering, coordinating with Amazon Robotics and Amazon Science on shared interests.

University Partnerships & Grants

Own the university grant program end-to-end: application, evaluation, awarding, and reporting.
Design and operate the access mechanisms that get robots into researchers’ hands — grant, phased-access, and fellows-style programs, including eligibility, selection, onboarding, and program goals.
Run pilots end-to-end; remove trust, funding, and technical blockers; drive real activation, retention, and expansion.
Partner with Fauna Science and Scholars on program design and relationships with target universities.
Support the Fauna intern program, linking academic partnerships to the talent pipeline.

External Engagement & Community

Represent Fauna at key conferences (ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI) — sponsorships, workshops, talks, and demos.
Convene and manage a Research Advisory Board to guide program design and the hardware/software roadmaps.
Amplify state-of-the-art partner research and results on Fauna robots, in partnership with our marketing team.

Research Experience & Product Feedback

Own the researcher relationship and experience for the university/research fleet — onboarding, enablement, and satisfaction.
Partner with product and leadership to define what we want out of research: which capabilities it pressure-tests, what feedback should shape the hardware and software roadmaps, and how it strengthens Fauna.
Translate community requirements into prioritized input for product and engineering.
Turn early usage into product feedback, case studies, peer proof, and repeatable enablement.
Partner with fleet operations and data/telemetry teams to keep researchers productive and their robots healthy.

Metrics & Reporting

Define the program’s KPIs — robots deployed and utilization, researcher activation / retention / expansion, researcher NPS, publications on Fauna robots, community engagement, and grant pipeline health — and use them to inform strategy and leadership reviews.

About The Team

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
7+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related field.
8+ years in program management, business development, partnerships, or research/developer relations.
History of working tightly with scientists, AI researchers, and academic institutions — and fluency in academic motions (conferences, labs, grant and sponsored-research cycles).
Experience navigating complex institutions — researchers, research IT, procurement, funders, and administrators.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD or funded-lab research experience; established credibility with R1 researchers.
Experience managing university grant or sponsored-research programs.
Consultative or technical sales experience selling into higher-education or research institutions, including their procurement and funding cycles.
Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in robotics, AI, engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience in robotics or with robotic systems.
Experience with sales, channel, or go-to-market motion — bringing a new product to new customers and growing adoption through direct and partner-led paths.
Experience building developer/research communities or programs.
Product experience — comfortable translating user needs into roadmap input.

jobs.title: Sr. Principal, PMT, APM, Amazon Publisher Monetization, Amazon Ads
jobs.description:
Description

Our Local & Services Advertising business serves the multi-billion dollar US local advertising market segment. We are building a portfolio of AI-powered ad experiences across Amazon owned & operated properties that will connect customers with the best local and services businesses in ways that feel natural, helpful, and seamless. This role will own the end-to-end product vision and execution for this business.

As Sr. Principal, Product Manager - Technical for Local & Services Advertising, you will define the multi-year strategy and drive execution for one of the most ambitious new advertising categories at Amazon. You will own the product lifecycle across multiple ad formats, multiple surfaces, and multiple demand channels. You will partner with engineering, science, and design teams building agentic AI systems that understand full conversation context, dynamically render locally-aware creatives, and drive seamless task completion for customers. You will build consensus across organizational boundaries to deliver a coherent advertiser and customer experience.

This is a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity role requiring collaboration across sales and product marketing to define and scale go-to-market. The leader should thrive on building zero-to-one, bring deep advertising technology expertise, and possess the technical judgment to make the right architecture and product decisions across AI/ML systems, ad serving infrastructure, and cross-surface experiences. You will influence VP and SVP-level strategy, and be accountable for business outcomes measured in billions of dollars.

Key job responsibilities

Product Vision & Strategy

Own and articulate the 3-5 year product vision for Local & Services Advertising, defining how we drive adoption and business growth through differentiated AI-powered experiences

Define the strategy for the new ad product across all Amazon surfaces, including the expansion roadmap across verticals, geographies, and demand sources

Own the P/L and revenue trajectory, making investment decisions that maximize long-term customer and business value

Cross-Surface Product Architecture

Define the product architecture that enables local and services ads to work coherently across Amazon's diverse publishers (e.g., Alexa, Fire TV, Stores etc.)

Own the integration strategy between Services/Local Ads, Conversational Ads, and display/video ad formats to deliver a unified full-funnel experience for local advertisers

Design the agentic task completion experience that enables customers to discover, evaluate, and transact with local service providers

Technical Leadership

Partner with engineering and science teams to define the AI/ML systems powering local ad relevance, including LLM-based contextual targeting, location-aware dynamic creative optimization, and real-time intent signals

Evaluate technical tradeoffs across ad serving infrastructure, privacy-safe agentic AI layers, and cross-surface orchestration systems

Drive architecture decisions for demand ingestion across multiple buying interfaces (Amazon Ads Console, ADSP, API) and demand sources

Ensure solutions scale to serve millions of local advertisers across multiple verticals while maintaining sub-second latency and high relevance

Demand Diversification & Partnerships

Define the demand diversification strategy across distinct buyer personas

Own the product requirements that enable frictionless onboarding for partners, while building toward self-service tools for millions of SMBs

Work with Sales leadership to define the go-to-market strategy that bootstraps demand at scale

Cross-Organizational Alignment

Build consensus and influence roadmaps across APM (supply and CX), SPB (demand and ad serving), Alexa+ (conversational AI), Publisher Partners (e.g., Fire TV), and Sales & Product Marketing (demand generation)

Drive strategic communications including decision narratives, investment proposals, annual planning narratives, and SVP-level business reviews

Act as the single-threaded owner accountable for end-to-end outcomes across organizational boundaries

Innovation & Thought Leadership

Identify and pursue breakthrough opportunities that leverage Amazon's unique value proposition

Define how generative AI and agentic systems fundamentally change local advertising from static impressions to intelligent, conversation-driven task completion

Establish best practices and mechanisms that scale the Local & Services Advertising business and develop the next generation of product leaders

About The Team

We sit at the intersection of Amazon Ads, Alexa+, and Amazon's first-party publisher network. Our mission is to unlock the massive local and services advertising opportunity by building AI-native advertising products that are genuinely useful to customers and transformatively effective for advertisers. We are a cross-functional team spanning product, engineering, science, and design, building products that touch hundreds of millions of customers across every Amazon surface. We are in the early stages of a business that will generate billions in revenue, and we are looking for a technical product leader who can see around corners, make bold bets, and deliver results at scale.

Amazon Ads is building a new category of advertising that connects hundreds of millions of customers with local and services businesses at the exact moment of intent, powered by Alexa+ agentic AI. We are creating an advertising experience unlike anything that exists today: one where a customer watching a game on Fire TV can order from their favorite local restaurant through a simple voice command, where a shopper purchasing a kitchen faucet discovers a trusted plumber two miles away and books an appointment without leaving Amazon, and where a traveler asking Alexa about weekend plans completes a hotel reservation through natural conversation. This is the future of local advertising, and we are building it.

Basic Qualifications

12+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)
Experience leading engineering design projects and interacting with cross-functional teams
Experience facilitating discussions with senior leadership regarding technical / architectural trade-offs, best practices, and risk mitigation
Experience in B2B, digital advertising, and ad-tech products/services
Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building high-velocity ad products
Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)
Experience leading and influencing your team or organization, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
Experience managing technical products or online services
13+ years of building profitable partner ecosystems experience
Advanced technical degree, or Master's degree
Experience engaging and influencing C-level executives, both business and technical

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager,  Chief Accounting Office
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking a Senior IT Product & Delivery Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of our SAP S/4HANA Core Finance platform. This is a high-impact, AI-intensive leadership role at the intersection of enterprise finance technology and innovative artificial intelligence. You will drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, FICA, Treasury, and adjacent finance systems—while embedding AI and machine learning capabilities to transform how Adobe's finance organization operates.

You will collaborate with partners from the finance sector, data scientists, engineering teams, and C-suite customers to deliver intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and self-healing finance workflows. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA. It also demands an entrepreneurial approach to apply the latest advances in generative AI, agentic workflows, and large language models (LLMs) within a world-class finance ecosystem.

What You'll Do

S/4HANA Product Management Ownership
Serve as the primary product owner for S/4HANA Finance components including the General Ledger (Universal Journal), Payables and Receivables, FICA with Contract Accounts and Collections/Dispute Management, Treasury & Cash Management, Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting, Fixed Assets, and Cost Center/Profit Center Accounting.
Drive configuration, extension build, and integration architecture decisions in collaboration with solution architects and SAP Basis teams.
Manage integration touchpoints with Kyriba, Blackline, Databricks, GEP, and custom microservices—ensuring data integrity and real-time financial visibility.

Change agent — proven track record driving organizational adoption of exciting technologies, including managing change management workstreams.
Collaborative builder — skilled at cultivating trusted relationships with finance business owners, SAP, cloud vendors, and internal engineering.

Collaborator Engagement & Delivery Leadership

Partner closely with the Director of Global Accounting and Treasury leadership to align technology investments with finance transformation goals.
Write detailed product requirements, AI model cards, functional specs, and user stories consumed by engineering and design teams.
Drive agile ceremonies—sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews—while maintaining a clear line-of-sight from AI experiments to production deployments.
Build executive-ready arguments quantifying return on investment, time-to-value, and risk for AI-enabled initiatives.
Coordinate a cross-functional pod of engineers, QA specialists, finance SMEs, and data engineers.

Product Strategy & Technology-Informed Roadmap

Own and evolve the multi-year product roadmap for S/4HANA’s central finance module, prioritizing AI-first capabilities alongside foundational ERP improvements.
Define and champion an AI integration strategy spanning generative AI copilots, intelligent document processing, anomaly detection, and predictive close.
Find opportunities to embed SAP Business AI, Joule, and third-party LLMs (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI) into core finance workflows.
Conduct competitive analysis and stay current on SAP release cycles, AI advancements, and FinTech trends to continuously sharpen the roadmap.

AI Feature Delivery & Innovation

Lead delivery of AI-powered capabilities including automated GL account coding and journal entry validation, intelligent AP/AR matching and dispute resolution, natural language querying of financial data via LLM-powered interfaces, predictive cash flow forecasting and working capital optimization, real-time anomaly detection and fraud prevention using ML pipelines.
Partner with Adobe's AI/ML engineering teams and data scientists to design model training datasets, evaluate model performance, and define feedback loops for continuous improvement.
Collaborate with SAP and cloud hyper scalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to leverage embedded AI services within the S/4HANA digital platform.
Define responsible AI guardrails, bias mitigation frameworks, and explainable standards for all AI models embedded in finance workflows.

What you need to succeed

8+ years of experience in enterprise finance IT, with at least 7 years of hands on SAP S/4HANA or ECC Finance implementations.
Demonstrable experience delivering AI/ML-powered features within ERP or finance platforms (e.g., intelligent automation, NLP interfaces, predictive analytics).
Expert-level knowledge of S/4HANA Finance modules: GL (Universal Journal), AP, AR, FICA, RAR, Treasury, Asset Accounting.
Proven product management or IT delivery leadership track record—driving complex, multi-stakeholder programs from concept to production.
Strong grasp of GAAP, IFRS 15, ASC 606, and subscription business financial models.
Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company with subscription revenue models and solid understanding of SAP Order to Cash processes.
Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA analytics (Databricks, SAP Analytics Cloud), procurement (Ariba or GEP or Coupa), and cloud data platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), SAP Build, or SAP Extension Suite for custom AI development.
Familiarity with timely engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen) applied to enterprise data.
Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and GDPR/CCPA compliance for finance data managed by automated systems.
Hands-on familiarity with at least one AI/ML toolchain: Azure OpenAI Service, Google’s Vertex AI platform, AWS SageMaker, SAP AI Core, or equivalent.
SAP S/4HANA Finance certification or SAP Activate methodology training.

Leadership & Soft Skills

Visionary communicator — able to translate AI/ML concepts and technical architecture to Senior Leadership, Controller, and Board-level audiences.
Strategic operator — comfortable navigating ambiguity, building consensus, and accelerating decisions in a matrixed environment.
Talent multiplier — experience mentoring finance technologists and encouraging a culture of continuous learning and AI literacy.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

jobs.description:
Description

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon’s vast distribution network as a service. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our world-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon’s Marketplaces.

In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.

Every year, billions of packages flow through Amazon's global fulfillment network. The physical configuration of that packaging directly dictates our fulfillment velocity, robotic handling efficiency, and cross-border marketplace compliance. Right now, our team owns one of the absolute largest, highest-leverage cost-reduction opportunities across the entire company: re-architecting upstream seller packaging to unlock Multi-Billion dollars of annual Cost to Serve (CTS) network savings entitlement.

We are looking for a strategic, highly technical Principal PMT to drive our AI-driven packaging optimization ecosystem. As the product leader of this domain, you will lead a cross-functional pod of senior software developers, data scientists, and robotics engineers to translate complex, multimodal logistics and physics telemetry into a single, automated, one-click optimization journey for our global selling partners.

Key job responsibilities

Own the Architecture & Vision: Drive the end-to-end product strategy, technical roadmap, and PRD/BRD definitions for the Seller-facing packaging platform. Turn abstract policy and engineering constraints into highly scalable, automated software features.

Lead Multi-Agent AI Integration: Partner with our Science pods to build and scale multimodal agentic systems that evaluates text metadata, 6-sided canonical imagery, and robotic manipulation video clips to drive SIPP (Ship in Product Packaging) adoption faster.

Drive Cross-Org Alignment: Build cross-org packaging strategy across Business and Tech with critical partner teams, including Fulfillment Tech & Robotics (FTR) and SCOTs.

Systemic Supply Chain Optimization: Oversee the technical integration of diverse optimization vectors, including the CRISP model for cube reduction, Box-Packing Recommendations (BPR) inside the inbound workflow, and a universal global labeling panel standard that automatically unlocks multi-marketplace compliance by default.

Scale the Future: Drive rapid go-to-market strategy for Sellers to adopt our recommendation. Unblock Sellers by creating manufacture-ready specifications and integration with service providers to drive zero-friction adoption.

A day in the life

Your day begins by tracking the real-world impact of your software, analyzing how thousands of international merchants use your platform to optimize their packaging and reduce shipping costs.In the morning, you solve high-ambiguity system challenges with senior engineers, designing intelligent conversational tools that translate complex supply chain rules into automated seller actions.In the afternoon, you collaborate with international teams to build a marketplace roadmap enabling two million merchants to effortlessly source sustainable packaging.You close by framing a long-term strategic narrative for executive leadership, directly lowering network costs and pioneering overbox-free e-commerce at scale.

About The Team

Our team sits at the intersection of advanced technology, global logistics, and environmental sustainability. We are a cross-functional pod of software engineers, data scientists, and supply chain innovators dedicated to solving one of the largest cost-reduction opportunities at Amazon. We move fast, think big, and embrace high ambiguity to turn manual, fragmented processes into elegant, automated software products. By building next-generation AI platforms and global digital marketplaces, we empower over two million business partners to optimize their networks. We value customer obsession, technical curiosity, and collaborative leadership as we pioneer a more efficient, sustainable future for global e-commerce.

Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

Description

Want to define how AWS responds when fraud or account compromise is detected? Join the AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team as a Senior Product Manager - External Services, where you will own the product strategy for real-time fraud enforcement across AWS.

AWS Fraud Prevention uses identity, account activity, payment, and service usage signals in machine learning models and AI systems to detect fraud and account compromise. This role will define how AWS turns those risk assessments into fast, consistent enforcement actions that protect customers and AWS across services and regions. You will own the strategy and roadmap for real-time enforcement, including reusable capabilities, customer safeguards, service adoption, and measures of speed and accuracy.

The ideal candidate has a strong track record of defining and delivering technical products at scale. You understand distributed systems, automated decision-making, and how to balance rapid fraud prevention with the impact on legitimate customers. You can also align teams across AWS around a common product strategy and technical approach.

Key job responsibilities

Real-Time Enforcement Strategy: Own the vision and roadmap for how AWS turns risk assessments into consistent enforcement actions. Define reusable capabilities that help mitigate fraud across all AWS services without building a separate solution for each use case.

Reliable Execution: Define product and technical requirements for enforcement actions that must complete in real-time. Partner with Engineering to ensure enforcement is scalable, observable, and resilient across services and regions.

Policy and Customer Safeguards: Define how the severity and confidence of a risk assessment, customer context, and potential impact determine the appropriate response. Establish requirements for actions, customer communication, auditability, human review when needed, and paths to recovery.

AWS Service Adoption: Expand real-time enforcement across AWS compute, AI, Marketplace, and emerging products. Identify coverage gaps, prioritize integrations, and make enforcement readiness part of product launch planning.

Measurement and Improvement:Track time to action, execution success, automation coverage, false positives, customer recovery, and prevented fraud loss.

Cross-Functional Leadership:Partner with AWS service teams, Identity, Security, Customer Service, Engineering, Science, Legal, and product leaders. Align teams on priorities, resolve trade-offs between fraud prevention and customer experience, and represent the domain in executive reviews.

jobs.description:
Description

Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) is a Senior Leadership Team mission to remove unnecessary cost in Amazon's retail business, anchored to a shared S-Team goal of $5B Cost Out Impact (COI) in 2026, scaling to a proposed $10B in 2027. UDE requires a myriad of mechanisms and we're in search of a Principal Product Manager to lead the development of the software platform portfolio from within the Retail Business Services team to manage all defects.

Retail Business Services (RBS) is the force multiplier team for Amazon's Retail business growth worldwide through three core strategic initiatives: (1) Defect Elimination, identifying cross-all-retail defects at their root cause and driving extirpation to increase margins; (2) Selection, creating and enriching Amazon inventory data increasing gross merchandise sales growth; and, (3) Operational Excellence, to ensure Amazon's retail business is running efficiently and effectively.

RBS evolving a horizontal internal platform complete with a front-end interface to oversee our UDE program; and, we need an experienced Principal Product Manager to own product vision and lead a small, growing team of product managers as a player-coach across our tracking, reporting, identification, and extrapolation products. This role has significantly evolved in last couple of years, with additional products and capabilities expected to be either ramped up or developed.

As the Principal Product Manager, you would own the development life cycle of our UDE platform portfolio spanning defect tracking, reporting. Own the tool which uses AI for defect identification, and extrapolation to enrich defects with root cause, upstream system, and system owner built with an AI-first development philosophy. Moreover, the leader will lead efforts on simplifying underlying data architectures (with help of dedicated BIE team and central Data Engineering team) for ease of usage of these products, while leading the impact assessment capabilities. It is expected for the leader to continue pushing the envelope on thought leadership via 3YP and Annual plans, which aid not just RBS users, but larger Amazon teams in identifying defects, analyzing and root causing them, assess their impact. The leader is epected to lead a small team to begin with. RBS is investing in this space and depending on forward looking vision, we expect this to become a much larger role with larger team being managed.

Operating in ambiguity, you would define strategy and invent net-new mechanisms; the day-to-day responsibilities include but are not limited to removing org-level blockers; ensuring teams are tracking to committed timelines; defining deep product feature requirements; developing a road map; aligning with stakeholders; collaborating with partner teams; and ensuring a successful, on-time launch.

Work/Life Balance

RBS puts a high value on work-life harmony. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Also, we provide trainings to employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications.

Key job responsibilities

Experience of managing complex business processes at scale.
Drive end-to-end high impact and high visibility programs that impact WW Retail and hence customer experience on Amazon
Communication and executive presence with an ability to deal with a fast-paced environment.
Experience in defining, developing and using metrics to drive the vision and manage the business.
Analyze data and dive deep into processes to derive insights for enhancing systems
Ability to lead not only at the strategic level, but also tactically day-to-day by diving deeply into business and technical domains.
Set AI/ML product strategy, prioritizing capabilities and making build-vs-buy calls across the portfolio.

Ability to work effectively & independently in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.

jobs.description:

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Scale Test

Today, customers facing high-stakes launches, multi-org transformations, or seasonal traffic spikes operate in the dark — hoping their systems scale rather than knowing they will. Scale Test changes that equation. Scale Test is Salesforce's native, comprehensive performance testing platform - the only solution that scans your production org to generate AI-powered test plan insights, then transforms your Full Copy Sandbox into a production-like environment for true scale validation.

Our mission: make any developer a performance engineer through a low-code, intuitive test automation experience.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to led the Scale Test product. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of platform engineering, enterprise customer success, and AI-driven testing innovation.

You won't just manage a backlog — you'll be a strategic owner who deeply understands how our largest customers architect and test their Salesforce implementations, translates that into a compelling product roadmap, and drives Scale Test toward its next phase of growth across Agentforce, Partners, and GovCloud.

What You'll Do

Customer & Market Engagement

Serve as the primary PM interface for enterprise customers running Scale Test, working closely with them through complex, time-sensitive testing windows to gather deep technical feedback
Partner with ISVs, SIs, and GovCloud customers to understand their unique testing requirements (e.g., data residency, compliance, FedRamp) and drive feature development accordingly
Translate complex enterprise customer scenarios — from Hyperforce migrations to Agentforce go-lives to peak load events — into clear, prioritized product specs and user stories

Product Strategy & Roadmap

Own the prioritized roadmap for Scale Test — covering test plan creation, test scheduler, test execution, load generation, UI script recorder/builder, and AI-powered features (Scale Agent, AI Script Healing)
Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Scale Test across multiple engineering teams (managed load generation, analytics platform, DevOps integration)
Define and drive the Agentforce testing strategy — understanding how customers build and validate Agentforce implementations at scale and driving features to support their go-lives
Lead the Vibe Testing capabilities roadmap: enabling PMs, admins, and non-engineers to intuitively define, run, and interpret performance tests through natural language and AI-guided flows — reducing reliance on scripting expertise and democratizing scale testing across teams
Drive the Pilot-to-GA pipeline for cutting-edge capabilities including Scale Agent (AI assistant for test analysis), Load Generation, and AI Script Healing
Stay ahead of industry trends in performance testing, AI/Agentforce workload patterns, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise DevOps practices

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work across Salesforce product teams (Agentforce, Data Cloud, Hyperforce, Platform) to ensure Scale Test integrates effectively and is positioned as a required step in every major go-live
Partner with Sales, AEs, CSMs, and Solution Architects on GTM strategies — including sales plays, competitive positioning, customer enablement, and new market expansion
Collaborate with the enablement team on Trailhead modules, internal FAQs, sales canvases, and persona-based selling guides

Execution & Delivery

Drive sprint planning, feature scoping, and launch readiness across engineering and research teams
Define success metrics and monitor product KPIs — including RPS thresholds tested, scale test days consumed, customer satisfaction, and renewal rates
Represent Scale Test at customer conversations, TDX/Dreamforce sessions, partner discussions, and internal executive reviews

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 4+ years in a B2B SaaS or platform product role.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or technical field; MBA or Master's degree in Business, Product Management, or related field a plus
Demonstrated experience owning complex, technically deep products end-to-end — from discovery through launch and iteration
Strong technical fluency — ability to engage meaningfully with engineering on infrastructure, load generation, APIs, and system design without needing to code
Track record of working directly with enterprise customers to surface insights and drive product improvements — ideally in performance-sensitive or platform contexts
Excellent communication and storytelling skills — equally comfortable in an engineering sprint review, a customer-facing demo, and an executive business review
Ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and make high-quality decisions with incomplete information
Prior experience with performance testing, load testing, or developer tooling products (e.g., LoadRunner, JMeter, or similar)
Agentic testing experience — you've built or managed products that test AI agents, agentic workflows, or autonomous systems; you understand how to validate quality, reliability, and performance for non-deterministic AI systems
Deep technical fluency across performance testing, load generation, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes), and SaaS architecture — able to engage deeply with engineering teams and communicate clearly to executive audiences
Experience with testing/observability/monitoring products — you've built or managed products in the DevOps toolchain (load testing, APM, observability, CI/CD, test automation)

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on exposure to Agentforce, Hyperforce, Salesforce Platform, or adjacent Salesforce products
Deep knowledge of Salesforce platform — multi-tenant SaaS architecture, sandboxes (Full Copy, Partial Copy, Developer), Hyperforce, governor limits, metadata model, Apex/LWC performance
Experience with Salesforce developer tooling or platform products — DevOps Center, Code Analyzer, Optimizer, CLI, VS Code extensions, or similar DX products
Understanding of Agentforce testing needs — what metrics matter (prompt latency, action execution time, LLM error rates, agent success rate, reasoning quality), how to measure quality at scale
Experience working with Partners (ISVs / SIs) and managing partner-driven product requirements
Familiarity with GovCloud / public sector requirements including FedRamp or equivalent data residency standards
Passion for democratizing developer tooling — making complex workflows accessible to non-engineers through low-code and AI-guided experiences (Vibe Testing)
BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)
Experience driving Pilot-to-GA product launches with strong customer feedback loops

Why Join Us

High visibility, high ownership: Scale Test is a fast-growing product with direct executive attention and a clear path to significant revenue impact
Real enterprise impact: Your work directly helps some of Salesforce's most demanding enterprise customers go live with confidence at production scale
AI at the core: Shape how Agentforce implementations are validated at scale — a uniquely forward-looking problem space
Full product lifecycle ownership: From Pilots (Scale Agent, AI Script Healing, Vibe Testing) to GA releases to new market expansion (GovCloud, Partners, global enterprise)
Career growth: Build and own a high-growth product on a team that operates with startup velocity inside Salesforce's global scale

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

You'll own the strategy, the relationships, and the sales channel end-to-end — from a researcher's first pilot to institution-wide adoption. You will own how labs evaluate, acquire, and expand their Fauna fleets. You'll design the grant and phased-access programs that put robots in researchers' hands, and run the pilots that prove them out. You'll represent Fauna where researchers gather — ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI — and cultivate a community of people building on our platform.

You will be Fauna’s primary point of engagement with the robotics research community. You’ll own the strategy and the relationships end-to-end — from qualifying a priority lab to scaling adoption across an entire institution. You’ll design the grant and phased-access programs that put robots in researchers’ hands, and run the pilots that prove them out. You’ll represent Fauna where researchers gather — ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI — and cultivate a community of people building on our platform. And you’ll own the sales channel for the segment — the paths by which labs evaluate, acquire, and expand their Fauna fleets.

Just as importantly, you’ll be the bridge between that community and our product org — translating what researchers discover into a clearer roadmap, better robots, and a stronger talent pipeline. This is a role for someone who works shoulder-to-shoulder with scientists and AI researchers, knows the rhythms of academic life, and wants to build the definitive research robotics platform with them.

This role owns the research/academic segment end-to-end as its relationship, program, sales, and customer-success lead. Own the sales channel for the research segment — the paths by which labs and institutions acquire, deploy, and grow their Fauna fleets, always grounded in research fit.
Partner with fleet operations, finance, and legal to structure the grant, sponsored-research, pricing, and purchase options that fit how universities actually buy.
Build repeatable paths and clean handoffs from an individual researcher to lab- and institution-wide adoption.
Serve as the connection between Amazon-internal research and academic teams and Fauna product/engineering, coordinating with Amazon Robotics and Amazon Science on shared interests.

University Partnerships & Grants

Own the university grant program end-to-end: application, evaluation, awarding, and reporting.
Design and operate the access mechanisms that get robots into researchers’ hands — grant, phased-access, and fellows-style programs, including eligibility, selection, onboarding, and program goals.

Convene and manage a Research Advisory Board to guide program design and the hardware/software roadmaps.
Amplify state-of-the-art partner research and results on Fauna robots, in partnership with our marketing team.

Research Experience & Product Feedback

Own the researcher relationship and experience for the university/research fleet — onboarding, enablement, and satisfaction.
Partner with product and leadership to define what we want out of research: which capabilities it pressure-tests, what feedback should shape the hardware and software roadmaps, and how it strengthens Fauna.
Translate community requirements into prioritized input for product and engineering.
Turn early usage into product feedback, case studies, peer proof, and repeatable enablement.
Partner with fleet operations and data/telemetry teams to keep researchers productive and their robots healthy.

About The Team

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Description

Our Local & Services Advertising business serves the multi-billion dollar US local advertising market segment. We are building a portfolio of AI-powered ad experiences across Amazon owned & operated properties that will connect customers with the best local and services businesses in ways that feel natural, helpful, and seamless. This role will own the end-to-end product vision and execution for this business.

As Sr. Principal, Product Manager - Technical for Local & Services Advertising, you will define the multi-year strategy and drive execution for one of the most ambitious new advertising categories at Amazon. You will own the product lifecycle across multiple ad formats, multiple surfaces, and multiple demand channels. You will partner with engineering, science, and design teams building agentic AI systems that understand full conversation context, dynamically render locally-aware creatives, and drive seamless task completion for customers. You will build consensus across organizational boundaries to deliver a coherent advertiser and customer experience.

This is a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity role requiring collaboration across sales and product marketing to define and scale go-to-market. The leader should thrive on building zero-to-one, bring deep advertising technology expertise, and possess the technical judgment to make the right architecture and product decisions across AI/ML systems, ad serving infrastructure, and cross-surface experiences. You will influence VP and SVP-level strategy, and be accountable for business outcomes measured in billions of dollars.

Key job responsibilities

Product Vision & Strategy

Own and articulate the 3-5 year product vision for Local & Services Advertising, defining how we drive adoption and business growth through differentiated AI-powered experiences

Define the strategy for the new ad product across all Amazon surfaces, including the expansion roadmap across verticals, geographies, and demand sources

Own the P/L and revenue trajectory, making investment decisions that maximize long-term customer and business value

Cross-Surface Product Architecture

Own the integration strategy between Services/Local Ads, Conversational Ads, and display/video ad formats to deliver a unified full-funnel experience for local advertisers

Design the agentic task completion experience that enables customers to discover, evaluate, and transact with local service providers

Technical Leadership

Partner with engineering and science teams to define the AI/ML systems powering local ad relevance, including LLM-based contextual targeting, location-aware dynamic creative optimization, and real-time intent signals

Evaluate technical tradeoffs across ad serving infrastructure, privacy-safe agentic AI layers, and cross-surface orchestration systems

Drive architecture decisions for demand ingestion across multiple buying interfaces (Amazon Ads Console, ADSP, API) and demand sources

Ensure solutions scale to serve millions of local advertisers across multiple verticals while maintaining sub-second latency and high relevance

Demand Diversification & Partnerships

Define the demand diversification strategy across distinct buyer personas

Own the product requirements that enable frictionless onboarding for partners, while building toward self-service tools for millions of SMBs

Work with Sales leadership to define the go-to-market strategy that bootstraps demand at scale

Cross-Organizational Alignment

Build consensus and influence roadmaps across APM (supply and CX), SPB (demand and ad serving), Alexa+ (conversational AI), Publisher Partners (e.g., Fire TV), and Sales & Product Marketing (demand generation)

Drive strategic communications including decision narratives, investment proposals, annual planning narratives, and SVP-level business reviews

Act as the single-threaded owner accountable for end-to-end outcomes across organizational boundaries

Innovation & Thought Leadership

Identify and pursue breakthrough opportunities that leverage Amazon's unique value proposition

Define how generative AI and agentic systems fundamentally change local advertising from static impressions to intelligent, conversation-driven task completion

Establish best practices and mechanisms that scale the Local & Services Advertising business and develop the next generation of product leaders

About The Team

We sit at the intersection of Amazon Ads, Alexa+, and Amazon's first-party publisher network. Our mission is to unlock the massive local and services advertising opportunity by building AI-native advertising products that are genuinely useful to customers and transformatively effective for advertisers. We are a cross-functional team spanning product, engineering, science, and design, building products that touch hundreds of millions of customers across every Amazon surface. We are in the early stages of a business that will generate billions in revenue, and we are looking for a technical product leader who can see around corners, make bold bets, and deliver results at scale.

Amazon Ads is building a new category of advertising that connects hundreds of millions of customers with local and services businesses at the exact moment of intent, powered by Alexa+ agentic AI. We are creating an advertising experience unlike anything that exists today: one where a customer watching a game on Fire TV can order from their favorite local restaurant through a simple voice command, where a shopper purchasing a kitchen faucet discovers a trusted plumber two miles away and books an appointment without leaving Amazon, and where a traveler asking Alexa about weekend plans completes a hotel reservation through natural conversation. The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking a Senior IT Product & Delivery Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of our SAP S/4HANA Core Finance platform. Collaborative builder — skilled at cultivating trusted relationships with finance business owners, SAP, cloud vendors, and internal engineering.

Write detailed product requirements, AI model cards, functional specs, and user stories consumed by engineering and design teams.

Build executive-ready arguments quantifying return on investment, time-to-value, and risk for AI-enabled initiatives.

Define responsible AI guardrails, bias mitigation frameworks, and explainable standards for all AI models embedded in finance workflows.

8+ years of experience in enterprise finance IT, with at least 7 years of hands on SAP S/4HANA or ECC Finance implementations.
Demonstrable experience delivering AI/ML-powered features within ERP or finance platforms (e.g., intelligent automation, NLP interfaces, predictive analytics).
Expert-level knowledge of S/4HANA Finance modules: GL (Universal Journal), AP, AR, FICA, RAR, Treasury, Asset Accounting.
Proven product management or IT delivery leadership track record—driving complex, multi-stakeholder programs from concept to production.
Strong grasp of GAAP, IFRS 15, ASC 606, and subscription business financial models.
Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company with subscription revenue models and solid understanding of SAP Order to Cash processes.
Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA analytics (Databricks, SAP Analytics Cloud), procurement (Ariba or GEP or Coupa), and cloud data platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), SAP Build, or SAP Extension Suite for custom AI development.
Familiarity with timely engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen) applied to enterprise data.
Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and GDPR/CCPA compliance for finance data managed by automated systems.
Hands-on familiarity with at least one AI/ML toolchain: Azure OpenAI Service, Google’s Vertex AI platform, AWS SageMaker, SAP AI Core, or equivalent.
SAP S/4HANA Finance certification or SAP Activate methodology training.

Leadership & Soft Skills

Visionary communicator — able to translate AI/ML concepts and technical architecture to Senior Leadership, Controller, and Board-level audiences.
Strategic operator — comfortable navigating ambiguity, building consensus, and accelerating decisions in a matrixed environment.
Talent multiplier — experience mentoring finance technologists and encouraging a culture of continuous learning and AI literacy.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon’s vast distribution network as a service. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our world-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon’s Marketplaces.

In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.

Every year, billions of packages flow through Amazon's global fulfillment network. The physical configuration of that packaging directly dictates our fulfillment velocity, robotic handling efficiency, and cross-border marketplace compliance. Right now, our team owns one of the absolute largest, highest-leverage cost-reduction opportunities across the entire company: re-architecting upstream seller packaging to unlock Multi-Billion dollars of annual Cost to Serve (CTS) network savings entitlement.

We are looking for a strategic, highly technical Principal PMT to drive our AI-driven packaging optimization ecosystem. As the product leader of this domain, you will lead a cross-functional pod of senior software developers, data scientists, and robotics engineers to translate complex, multimodal logistics and physics telemetry into a single, automated, one-click optimization journey for our global selling partners.

Key job responsibilities

Own the Architecture & Vision: Drive the end-to-end product strategy, technical roadmap, and PRD/BRD definitions for the Seller-facing packaging platform. Turn abstract policy and engineering constraints into highly scalable, automated software features.

Lead Multi-Agent AI Integration: Partner with our Science pods to build and scale multimodal agentic systems that evaluates text metadata, 6-sided canonical imagery, and robotic manipulation video clips to drive SIPP (Ship in Product Packaging) adoption faster.

Drive Cross-Org Alignment: Build cross-org packaging strategy across Business and Tech with critical partner teams, including Fulfillment Tech & Robotics (FTR) and SCOTs.

Systemic Supply Chain Optimization: Oversee the technical integration of diverse optimization vectors, including the CRISP model for cube reduction, Box-Packing Recommendations (BPR) inside the inbound workflow, and a universal global labeling panel standard that automatically unlocks multi-marketplace compliance by default.

Scale the Future: Drive rapid go-to-market strategy for Sellers to adopt our recommendation. Unblock Sellers by creating manufacture-ready specifications and integration with service providers to drive zero-friction adoption.

A day in the life

Your day begins by tracking the real-world impact of your software, analyzing how thousands of international merchants use your platform to optimize their packaging and reduce shipping costs.In the morning, you solve high-ambiguity system challenges with senior engineers, designing intelligent conversational tools that translate complex supply chain rules into automated seller actions.In the afternoon, you collaborate with international teams to build a marketplace roadmap enabling two million merchants to effortlessly source sustainable packaging.You close by framing a long-term strategic narrative for executive leadership, directly lowering network costs and pioneering overbox-free e-commerce at scale.

About The Team

Our team sits at the intersection of advanced technology, global logistics, and environmental sustainability. We are a cross-functional pod of software engineers, data scientists, and supply chain innovators dedicated to solving one of the largest cost-reduction opportunities at Amazon. We move fast, think big, and embrace high ambiguity to turn manual, fragmented processes into elegant, automated software products. By building next-generation AI platforms and global digital marketplaces, we empower over two million business partners to optimize their networks. We value customer obsession, technical curiosity, and collaborative leadership as we pioneer a more efficient, sustainable future for global e-commerce.

Bachelor's degree
10+ years of technical product or program management experience
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

Description

Want to define how AWS responds when fraud or account compromise is detected? Join the AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team as a Senior Product Manager - External Services, where you will own the product strategy for real-time fraud enforcement across AWS.

AWS Fraud Prevention uses identity, account activity, payment, and service usage signals in machine learning models and AI systems to detect fraud and account compromise. This role will define how AWS turns those risk assessments into fast, consistent enforcement actions that protect customers and AWS across services and regions. You will own the strategy and roadmap for real-time enforcement, including reusable capabilities, customer safeguards, service adoption, and measures of speed and accuracy.

The ideal candidate has a strong track record of defining and delivering technical products at scale. You understand distributed systems, automated decision-making, and how to balance rapid fraud prevention with the impact on legitimate customers. You can also align teams across AWS around a common product strategy and technical approach.

Key job responsibilities

Real-Time Enforcement Strategy: Own the vision and roadmap for how AWS turns risk assessments into consistent enforcement actions. Define reusable capabilities that help mitigate fraud across all AWS services without building a separate solution for each use case.

Reliable Execution: Define product and technical requirements for enforcement actions that must complete in real-time. Partner with Engineering to ensure enforcement is scalable, observable, and resilient across services and regions.

Policy and Customer Safeguards: Define how the severity and confidence of a risk assessment, customer context, and potential impact determine the appropriate response. Establish requirements for actions, customer communication, auditability, human review when needed, and paths to recovery.

AWS Service Adoption: Expand real-time enforcement across AWS compute, AI, Marketplace, and emerging products. Identify coverage gaps, prioritize integrations, and make enforcement readiness part of product launch planning.

Measurement and Improvement:Track time to action, execution success, automation coverage, false positives, customer recovery, and prevented fraud loss.

Cross-Functional Leadership:Partner with AWS service teams, Identity, Security, Customer Service, Engineering, Science, Legal, and product leaders. Align teams on priorities, resolve trade-offs between fraud prevention and customer experience, and represent the domain in executive reviews.

Description

Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) is a Senior Leadership Team mission to remove unnecessary cost in Amazon's retail business, anchored to a shared S-Team goal of $5B Cost Out Impact (COI) in 2026, scaling to a proposed $10B in 2027. UDE requires a myriad of mechanisms and we're in search of a Principal Product Manager to lead the development of the software platform portfolio from within the Retail Business Services team to manage all defects.

Retail Business Services (RBS) is the force multiplier team for Amazon's Retail business growth worldwide through three core strategic initiatives: (1) Defect Elimination, identifying cross-all-retail defects at their root cause and driving extirpation to increase margins; (2) Selection, creating and enriching Amazon inventory data increasing gross merchandise sales growth; and, (3) Operational Excellence, to ensure Amazon's retail business is running efficiently and effectively.

RBS evolving a horizontal internal platform complete with a front-end interface to oversee our UDE program; and, we need an experienced Principal Product Manager to own product vision and lead a small, growing team of product managers as a player-coach across our tracking, reporting, identification, and extrapolation products. This role has significantly evolved in last couple of years, with additional products and capabilities expected to be either ramped up or developed.

As the Principal Product Manager, you would own the development life cycle of our UDE platform portfolio spanning defect tracking, reporting. Own the tool which uses AI for defect identification, and extrapolation to enrich defects with root cause, upstream system, and system owner built with an AI-first development philosophy. Moreover, the leader will lead efforts on simplifying underlying data architectures (with help of dedicated BIE team and central Data Engineering team) for ease of usage of these products, while leading the impact assessment capabilities. It is expected for the leader to continue pushing the envelope on thought leadership via 3YP and Annual plans, which aid not just RBS users, but larger Amazon teams in identifying defects, analyzing and root causing them, assess their impact. The leader is epected to lead a small team to begin with. RBS is investing in this space and depending on forward looking vision, we expect this to become a much larger role with larger team being managed.

Operating in ambiguity, you would define strategy and invent net-new mechanisms; the day-to-day responsibilities include but are not limited to removing org-level blockers; ensuring teams are tracking to committed timelines; defining deep product feature requirements; developing a road map; aligning with stakeholders; collaborating with partner teams; and ensuring a successful, on-time launch.

Today, customers facing high-stakes launches, multi-org transformations, or seasonal traffic spikes operate in the dark — hoping their systems scale rather than knowing they will. Scale Test changes that equation. Scale Test is Salesforce's native, comprehensive performance testing platform - the only solution that scans your production org to generate AI-powered test plan insights, then transforms your Full Copy Sandbox into a production-like environment for true scale validation.

Our mission: make any developer a performance engineer through a low-code, intuitive test automation experience.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to led the Scale Test product. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of platform engineering, enterprise customer success, and AI-driven testing innovation.

You won't just manage a backlog — you'll be a strategic owner who deeply understands how our largest customers architect and test their Salesforce implementations, translates that into a compelling product roadmap, and drives Scale Test toward its next phase of growth across Agentforce, Partners, and GovCloud.

Translate complex enterprise customer scenarios — from Hyperforce migrations to Agentforce go-lives to peak load events — into clear, prioritized product specs and user stories

Own the prioritized roadmap for Scale Test — covering test plan creation, test scheduler, test execution, load generation, UI script recorder/builder, and AI-powered features (Scale Agent, AI Script Healing)
Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Scale Test across multiple engineering teams (managed load generation, analytics platform, DevOps integration)
Define and drive the Agentforce testing strategy — understanding how customers build and validate Agentforce implementations at scale and driving features to support their go-lives
Lead the Vibe Testing capabilities roadmap: enabling PMs, admins, and non-engineers to intuitively define, run, and interpret performance tests through natural language and AI-guided flows — reducing reliance on scripting expertise and democratizing scale testing across teams
Drive the Pilot-to-GA pipeline for cutting-edge capabilities including Scale Agent (AI assistant for test analysis), Load Generation, and AI Script Healing
Stay ahead of industry trends in performance testing, AI/Agentforce workload patterns, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise DevOps practices

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work across Salesforce product teams (Agentforce, Data Cloud, Hyperforce, Platform) to ensure Scale Test integrates effectively and is positioned as a required step in every major go-live
Partner with Sales, AEs, CSMs, and Solution Architects on GTM strategies — including sales plays, competitive positioning, customer enablement, and new market expansion
Collaborate with the enablement team on Trailhead modules, internal FAQs, sales canvases, and persona-based selling guides

Define success metrics and monitor product KPIs — including RPS thresholds tested, scale test days consumed, customer satisfaction, and renewal rates
Represent Scale Test at customer conversations, TDX/Dreamforce sessions, partner discussions, and internal executive reviews
